title: Hotel market cooler · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Two-door glass merchandiser, 1.35 x 0.72 x 2.05 m, stocked like a hotel lobby market: spring water, sports drinks, energy cans, colas and lemon-lime in 20 oz bottles, orange and root beer cans, juices, sweet tea, pint milk cartons and cold brew, faced two to four deep, each with a printed wrap label (cans show theirs between aluminium ends; coloured drinks are opaque so rows sort cleanly); LED-lit shelves, price rail, lit header. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/props.py); printed labels drawn by projects/roadside-inn/blender/labels.mjs, every brand invented. Meters, Y up, origin at floor center, front faces +Z.
